name: Power Bank (Lithium Battery)
description: Guidelines for traveling with power bank (lithium battery) in your luggage.

carryOn.reason: Lithium-ion power banks are strictly prohibited in checked baggage because of the risk of thermal runaway and fire in the cargo hold. They must be carried in the cabin.
conditions: Limited to a capacity of 100 watt-hours (Wh) per battery without airline approval.
Terminal connections must be protected from short circuits (e.g. by keeping in retail packaging or tape over terminals).

conditions: Limited to a capacity of 100 watt-hours (Wh) per battery without airline approval.

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring power bank (lithium battery) on a plane?

travelTips: Limited to a capacity of 100 watt-hours (Wh) per battery without airline approval.

faq.question: Is power bank (lithium battery) allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Power Bank (Lithium Battery) is allowed in carry-on luggage. Lithium-ion power banks are strictly prohibited in checked baggage because of the risk of thermal runaway and fire in the cargo hold. They must be carried in the cabin.

faq.question: Can you pack power bank (lithium battery) in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes, Power Bank (Lithium Battery) is not allowed in checked bags.
